text:
mia: Heads-up — midcycle is next week. I'm assembling a tiny 'blitz kit' for managers: 3-line evidence, 1 metric line, 1-line ask, plus a quick hiring ops note for any role handoffs. Want to keep it pasteable.
lara: love. can we make the evidence lines human-readable for calibrators (no jargon), and put the metric separate so it stands out?
rachel: +1. also add a micro-template for "if you're handing off because hiring" so we don't lose context when backfills happen.
tom: will mgmt people prefer formal tone or casual? maybe include both short variants.
priya: include a tiny "how to use" header so managers know where to paste each piece.
hr-bot: Reminder: calibration roster posted to the People Ops calendar.

mia: Draft Blitz Kit (paste in self-reviews, manager notes, or handoffs):

```
HOW TO USE: Paste the Evidence (1-3 lines) + Metric line, then one-line Ask. Use Manager Note when handing off.

EVIDENCE (choose up to 3 short bullets, plain english):
- Impact headline: [One-sentence summary of what changed for users or the business]
- Key action: [What you did to make it happen] -> [who benefited]
- Outcome snapshot: [One clear result or example customers saw]

METRIC LINE (single-line, numeric if available):
- Metric: [metric name] — baseline [X] -> now [Y] (delta: [+/-Z%])

ASK (one line, explicit):
- Ask: [specific support/time/headcount/priority change] — owner: @NAME

MANAGER HANDOFF NOTE (single-paragraph):
- Handoff: Current status [dev/stage/prod]; remaining scope [list of 1-2 items]; known risks [1-2]; docs: [link]; oncall/alerts: [link].

HIRING / BACKFILL CONTEXT (paste when role change/backfill):
- Role reason: [e.g., coverage for oncall, growth area, leadership gap]
- Succinct brief: What the hire needs to continue (3 bullets): 1) ownership area, 2) immediate project, 3) stakeholder list
- Suggested interview focus: [skills/behaviors to probe]

MANAGER TONE VARIANTS (one-liners you can paste in calibration):
- Formal: "Consistently delivered on prioritized objectives; measurable impact on [metric]."
- Conversational: "Made big progress on X, helped team move faster; would like support for Y."

MICRO-CHECKLIST (paste in issue description):
- [ ] Evidence + Metric added
- [ ] Docs & runbook linked
- [ ] Dashboards/alerts shared
- [ ] Handoff sync scheduled (15-30m)
- [ ] Hiring context attached (if backfill)
```

priya: This is tight and reusable. Can we also add a 3-line self-review starter that emphasizes decisions rather than tasks?
mia: yes, new micro-scaffold below.

```
SELF-REVIEW STARTER (3 lines):
1) Decision & reason: [what you decided and why] -> [impact]
2) Barrier moved: [what you removed or improved] -> [who benefited]
3) Help needed: [specific ask for manager/org]
```

rachel: i'll take these and make a one-pager in the handbook and attach a short link to the review form. tom: can you share a backfill example from eng so we can include a sanitized sample?
tom: yep, i'll send one by EOD.
lara: thanks all — last call for wording changes before i publish. small ask: keep every line <140 chars so it stays paste-friendly. :sparkles:
